name: Kd Tree Unrolling (JiTTree)
aliases: Kd Tree of Bricks with Partial Evaluation
definition: An optimization where the Kd tree traversal logic is unrolled into a sequence of nested conditionals at compile time (or JIT), eliminating pointer chasing and type routing overhead.
summary: JiTTree is a data structure optimization that unrolls a Kd Tree into nested conditionals via JIT compilation, eliminating pointer-chasing and type-checking overhead by baking splitting planes and specialized access logic directly into the traversal code.
